Title: Camera
Description: Every scene should have at least one Camera.

Properties.Name: ClearFlags
Properties.Title: Clear Flags
Properties.Description: The clear flags for this camera.

Properties.Name: BackgroundColor
Properties.Title: Background Color
Properties.Description: The background color of this camera's view if there's no 2D Sky in the scene.

Properties.Name: EnablePostProcessing
Properties.Title: Enable Post Processing
Properties.Description: Enable or disable post processing for this camera.

Properties.Name: PostProcessAnchor
Properties.Title: Post Process Anchor
Properties.Description: If set then we'll trigger post process volumes from this position, instead of the camera's position.

Properties.Name: IsMainCamera
Properties.Title: Is Main Camera
Properties.Description: Returns true if this is the main game camera.

Properties.Name: FovAxis
Properties.Title: FOV Axis
Properties.Description: The axis to use for the field of view.

Properties.Name: FieldOfView
Properties.Title: Field Of View
Properties.Description: The field of view of this camera.

Properties.Name: ZNear
Properties.Title: Znear
Properties.Description: The camera's near clip plane distance. This is the closest distance this camera will be able to render. A good value for this is about 5. Below 5 and particularly below 1 you're going to start to see a lot of artifacts like z-fighting.

Properties.Name: ZFar
Properties.Title: Zfar
Properties.Description: The camera's far clip plane distance. This is the furthest distance this camera will be able to render. This value totally depends on the game you're making. Shorter the better, sensible ranges would be between about 1000 and 30000, but if you want it to be further out you can balance that out by making ZNear larger.

Properties.Name: Priority
Properties.Title: Priority
Properties.Description: The priority of this camera. Dictates which camera gets rendered on top of another. Higher means it'll be rendered on top.

Properties.Name: Orthographic
Properties.Title: Orthographic
Properties.Description: Whether or not to use orthographic projection instead of perspective.

Properties.Name: OrthographicHeight
Properties.Title: Orthographic Height
Properties.Description: The orthographic size for this camera while CameraComponent.Orthographic is set to true.

Properties.Name: TargetEye
Properties.Title: Target Eye
Properties.Description: The HMD eye that this camera is targeting. Use StereoTargetEye.None for the user's monitor (i.e. the companion window).

Properties.Name: RenderTags
Properties.Title: Render Tags
Properties.Description: A list of tags that will be checked to include specific game objects when rendering this camera. If none are set, it will include everything.

Properties.Name: RenderExcludeTags
Properties.Title: Render Exclude Tags
Properties.Description: A list of tags that will be checked to exclude specific game objects when rendering this camera.

Properties.Name: Viewport
Properties.Title: Viewport
Properties.Description: The size of the camera represented on the screen. Normalized between 0 and 1.
